Question Choices: Select which unit is best for measuring the volume of a small dice: cubic-meters square-centimeters cubic-centimeters
Hints: A dice is small and volume is 3D
Solution: cubic-centimeters. A dice is small so not cubic-meters, and the volume is 3D so not square-centimeters.

Question Choices: An object has 4 layers and 5 cubes in each layer. Each cube is 3 cubic centimeters. The volume of this object is __ cubic centimeters
Hints: First find the total number of cubes. Then multiply number of cubes by the unit volume
Solution: 60 -> total number of cubes = 4 x 5 = 20. Then multiply number of cubes by the unit = 20 x 3 cubic centimeters = 60 cubic centimeters
